title: Tumble and the Runaway Red Kite
description: A gust of wind carries Tumble's brand-new kite away! With help from Pippa and Moss, Tumble learns that asking friends for help makes big problems feel small.
lesson: When something feels too big, it's okay to ask your friends for help.
thumbnail_visual: Tumble the bear cub joyfully holding the string of a bright red kite high in a blue sky over a flower meadow, Pippa the bird flying beside him

shots.visual: Wide shot of a sunny flower meadow in the morning with rolling green hills, Tumble the bear cub running happily while flying a bright red diamond kite with a tail of blue bows

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One breezy morning in Maple Meadow, Tumble the bear cub had a brand-new red kite.

lines.speaker: Tumble
lines.text: Up, up, up it goes! Wheee!

shots.visual: Close-up of Tumble looking up in surprise, paws open, as the red kite string slips away into the windy sky, leaves swirling

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then, whoosh! A big gust of wind tugged the string right out of his paws.

shots.visual: Medium shot at the edge of a friendly sunlit forest, Pippa the little blue bird perched on a low branch talking to a sad Tumble

lines.speaker: Pippa
lines.text: Tumble, why do you look so sad?

lines.speaker: Tumble
lines.text: My kite flew away. I tried to find it all by myself, but I can't.

lines.speaker: Pippa
lines.text: Then let's look together! Two eyes are good, but four eyes are better!

shots.visual: A calm pond with lily pads and tall reeds at golden afternoon, Moss the old tortoise with round spectacles smiling at Tumble and Pippa

lines.speaker: Moss
lines.text: Hello, little friends. I saw something red near the tall reeds.

lines.speaker: Moss
lines.text: Let's go slowly and look carefully, together.

shots.visual: Sunset over the pond, Tumble hugging his red kite with blue bows, Pippa and Moss cheering beside him, warm golden light

lines.speaker: Pippa
lines.text: One bow, two bows, three bows! It's your kite!

lines.speaker: Tumble
lines.text: You found it! Thank you, friends!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When something feels too big, it's okay to ask your friends for help. See you next time in Maple Meadow!

short.title: Where did Tumble's kite go?
short.description: Tumble's kite blows away, but his friends help him find it!

shots.visual: Tall vertical view of a bright red kite with blue bows flying high in a blue sky with fluffy clouds, Tumble small at the bottom on a meadow reaching up

lines.speaker: Tumble
lines.text: Oh no! The wind took my kite! Where did it go?

shots.visual: Vertical view of Pippa the blue bird flying above tall reeds by a pond, looking down and pointing with her wing

lines.speaker: Pippa
lines.text: I see something red! Can you spot it too?

shots.visual: Vertical close-up of Tumble hugging his red kite, Moss the tortoise smiling beside him at sunset

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Big problems feel small when friends help.
